name: Turbo Basic-Ex Aggro
description: Fast aggressive deck using high-HP Basic Pokemon-ex with strong single-energy attacks. Focuses on early pressure and consistent damage output with minimal setup.
win_condition: Take 6 prizes quickly by KO-ing opposing Pokemon with efficient Basic-ex attackers before opponent sets up their board.
backup_plan: If primary attacker is KO'd, pivot to secondary attacker on bench. Use gusting supporters to target weak bench Pokemon for easy prizes.

pokemon.name: Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex
pokemon.rationale: 260 HP Basic-ex with heavy damage. Needs colorless energy so flexible.

pokemon.name: Gouging Fire ex
pokemon.rationale: 230 HP Basic Ancient ex with strong attack.

pokemon.name: Iron Thorns ex
pokemon.rationale: 230 HP, Initialization ability shuts down opponent's Rule Box abilities.

pokemon.name: Eevee
pokemon.rationale: Low retreat Basic for early game flexibility.

pokemon.name: Morpeko
pokemon.rationale: Snack Seek ability for deck filtering + Pick and Stick for energy acceleration.

trainers.name: Boss's Orders
trainers.rationale: Force opponent's bench Pokemon active for easy KOs.

trainers.name: Nest Ball
trainers.rationale: Search Basic Pokemon to bench consistently.

trainers.name: Ultra Ball
trainers.rationale: Search any Pokemon with discard cost.

trainers.name: Iono
trainers.rationale: Draw + opponent hand disruption in late game.

energy.name: Spiky Energy
energy.rationale: Punishes opponent for attacking into active.

key_interactions: Iron Thorns ex shuts down opponent's abilities while attacking
Morpeko accelerates energy from discard to power up bench attackers
Boomerang Energy returns after discard for sustained aggression
Boss's Orders + high damage = pick off weak bench targets
